mechanism.claim: Within a completed eight-hour block, relocation of spot realized variation into the second four hours while perpetual variation does not relocate marks cash-market information arriving faster than derivatives path energy. If spot and perpetual agree on the final two-hour direction during a high-variation BTC regime, follow that direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed final-two-hour spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: SLVCR used one-hour return magnitude partial transmission plus BVOL/DVOL expansion; cash-basis, spot-flow, and spot-participation candidates use level wedges, aggressive flow, or volume share. SPVTA uses only two-half venue-specific path-energy relocation and final-two-hour direction, with no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: perpetual completed prior-24h realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed daily boundaries conditioned on spot-versus-perpetual path-energy relocation are absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.block: exact eight completed consecutive UTC hours [D-8h,D) for BTCUSDT spot and perpetual at D hour 00, 08, or 16
features.hour_valid: hash-bound source-valid positive open/close for both venues; no imputation
features.first_half_variation: sum squared hour_return over first four hours
features.second_half_variation: sum squared hour_return over final four hours
features.variation_share: second_half_variation divided by total eight-hour variation, independently by venue; positive total required
features.relocation: spot variation_share minus perpetual variation_share; strict positive
features.relocation_rank: strict-prior midrank of relocation over at most 90 prior valid blocks, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.final_two_hour_return: sum of final two completed hourly log returns independently by venue; both strict nonzero and same sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared perpetual hourly returns over 24 hours ending at D)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid decision blocks, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact D at UTC hour 00, 08, or 16 after all source rows complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no block, halves, geometry, relocation, rank, direction, side, hold, clock, volatility, or subset repair.
